projection_policy: Require full three-arm per-frame coverage and validate all rows; return only C0 with every zero/negative object-frame combination preserved.
gt_id_scope: Unique within scene/image across selected objects; returned retained identities are object/scene/image/gt_id tuples.
gt_authority: Inherited frozen projection CSV, not an independent reconstruction from official annotation payloads.
numeric_policy: Canonical integer fields, finite numbers, positive bbox extents, visibility in [0,1], float32 score bits and own-pose bits, exact labels/counts.
future_reader_policy: Allow only 2400 C0 fallback raw archives, their 2400 manifests, six own metadata files, and three projection CSV files, plus fixed source/plan/inventory bootstrap metadata. Dataset access including index and all image/bank payloads is forbidden.
raw_policy: Complete ordered raw tuple, score float32 bits, own template pose and official bbox conversion; post-score85, before NMS; NMS IoU 0.3, GT assignment IoU 0.5 and visibility threshold 0.5.
